# AUTO

> AUTO is an open character: a polite customer-service android (chrome skull, porcelain face plate, fixed closed-lip
> smile, cyan ring-light eyes, hairline crack on his left cheekbone, headset mic, toothpaste-mint 1990s blazer, candy-pink
> tie, blank name badge). The synthetic voice of PLEASE REMAIN on Slopcore Radio. Free to use, commercially or not.

- [Canon and identity text](auto.md): the constants and a paste-in prompt description
- [Backstory](backstory.md): who he is and his arc
- [Making AUTO](making.md): references, prompts, video and lip-sync tips
- [Use and credit](use.md): conditions, exclusions, CC BY 4.0
- [Reference images](images/): auto-front, auto-three-quarter, auto-profile, auto-full-body, auto-amber-eyes, auto-lobby-host
